{{Youmay|means of communicating information|[[Media (planet)]], an urban world in the Corporate Sector}}
'''Media''' are the channels and tools used for storing and transmitting information.

Many media, such as the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], relied on [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] technology. This was referred to as the '''holomedia'''. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[textfile]] "[[Why Do We Fight the Empire?]]" was released to the holomedia in the weeks following the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege|siege]] of [[Caprioril]].<ref name="Dark Empire Sourcebook">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The "gossip media" were the sources of information on celebrities and public figures. [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Alya Aldrete]] was heavily watched by the gossip media.<ref name="DoD 9">{{DoD|The Gem of Alderaan}}</ref>
